definition: A matched full/visible pair whose declared invariant-residue comparison differs cannot be identified after standard Q completion by a Q-isomorphism preserving the residue-bundle constituent.
math: r_H(B_full^R)≠r_H(B_vis^R) => B_full^R not~=_F B_vis^R => Q_full not~=_Q Q_vis (for residue-preserving Q morphisms).
